scope: Corollary B.1 (The dimension-scale parameter regime) of the manuscript “Memory and precision in noiseless Gaussian regression” (preprints/Memory-and-precision-in-noiseless-Gaussian-regression-September-27-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 140 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 a46ccc95821da009), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 30. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Under the hypotheses of Proposition 3.2, suppose that d ≥ 16, p = ⌊d/8⌋, 1 ≤ m ≤ p, d − 1 2 ≤ β ≤ d 2 , (67) Then, for every 0 ≤ j ≤ p − 2, β − j − m ≥ d − 1 2 − 2p + 2 ≥ d 4 + 3 2 , Jj ≤ Cd , (68) where C ≥ 1 is an absolute constant. Thus the right side of (14) is at most Cd(p−1)HpRβp−m(p−1), uniformly also for short blocks m < p.
